svg.title: Shapes, not just boxes
svg.desc: Shapes, not just boxes: an ergonomic mouse shell, 64.1 × 118.6 × 38.0 mm, lofted through rounded sections and hollowed to an even wall, with a thumb scoop, split buttons and a wheel slot.
svg.text: Ergonomic mouse shell · 64.1 × 118.6 × 38.0 mm · 1.8 mm wall
Lofted surfaces, scoops and splits, written as
code and built as solids you can still edit.
